Trains to Ayr

This is the train I would look at for the International Ayr Show. ScotRail normally runs a train every 30 minutes from Glasgow Central to Ayr, taking just over 50 minutes, and on the 2026 show Saturday it ran three trains an hour, with an hourly express calling only at Paisley Gilmour Street, Johnstone and Kilwinning. From England you’ll need to change at Glasgow Central, or at Kilmarnock. Ayr station is under a mile from the Low Green.
